title: Settings
description: Full settings of the Deskulpt application.

shortcuts.description:
The keyboard shortcuts.

This maps the actions to the shortcut strings that will trigger them.

snapThreshold.description:
Snap threshold in pixels when dragging or resizing widgets.

Edges or centers within this distance of another widget snap into
alignment. `0` disables snapping.

showGuides.description: Whether to show alignment guides while dragging or resizing widgets.

starterWidgetsAdded.description: Whether the starter widgets have been added.

Theme.description: The light/dark theme of the application interface.

oneOf.description:
Auto mode.

Automatically switch between sink and float modes based on mouse
position, so that users will feel like the widgets and the desktop are
simultaneously interactable.

Sink mode.

The canvas is click-through. Widgets are not interactable. The desktop
is interactable.

Float mode.

The canvas is not click-through. Widgets are interactable. The desktop
is not interactable.
